liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Standing On The Moon** (2 reviews): Had a huge ending that gave the crowd something to cheer about; One of a couple of second-set highlights [8][14]
- **Picasso Moon** (1 review): Opened the show with a thundering sound that led into everything after it [7]
- **Althea** (1 review): Reviewer calls this the worst Althea ever heard [8]
- **Here Comes Sunshine** (1 review): Opening the second set, it was a highlight, followed by Playin' into Uncle John's [6]

## The recordings

- **gd95-05-19.schoeps.18704.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): audience recording; 16 songs; 151 min; rated 2.76/5 by 20 [1]. Said about its sound: Audience recording sound quality is not the best, though the memories matter more; Uploader considers this the best audience recording of the show, with all band members audible; Minor level adjustments were made at the beginning of this song [1][7]
- **gd1995-05-19.153189.sony.bregman.miller.vernon.f1648**: source not stated; 16 songs; 153 min [3]. Said about its sound: A volume drop of about ten seconds occurs near the start; Some amplitude overload at the start, where levels were increased [3]
- **gd1995-05-19.aud.unknown.8600.shnf**: audience recording; 16 songs; 150 min; rated 0.5/5 by 2 [2]
- **gd1995-05-19.141345.FOB-mk4.ebel.flac1644**: source not stated; 16 songs; 149 min [4]

## Around the show

- Reviewer traveled from Antigonish, NS; the sheer size of the crowd made the show an experience [6]
- Reviewer's mother's Yugo was keyed in the parking lot during the outdoor show [9]
- Intense heat from the band and sun; the parking lot sky turned pink, purple and orange afterward [10]
- Reviewer bought tickets for their parents, who were vacationing in Las Vegas and had never been to a Dead show [12]
- Dave Matthews Band opened the show; the weather was steaming hot and the concrete too hot to sit on [15]
- Firehose showers were set up around the rim of the stadium; reviewer drove from Breckenridge, CO [15]
- Dave Matthews opened, and a shower in the parking lot kept fans hydrated [16]
- Deadheads with tie-dyes and dreadlocks filled the Circus Circus slots and card tables [16]
- Judged not the best of the three Las Vegas shows [6]
- First of three Vegas shows the reviewer attended, and the weakest, with a tepid first set [8]
- Called the worst of the three Vegas shows, with a throwaway first set [14]
- Second set was clearly surpassed on the following two nights; reviewer suggests starting with the 5/21 show [14]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd95-05-19.schoeps.18704.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Dan Sisler; transferred by Chris Larson; source: Audience: Schoeps MK4's [1]
- **gd1995-05-19.153189.sony.bregman.miller.vernon.f1648**: taped by Chris Bregman; transferred by Transfer by Charlie Miller Tracking/Tagging by Matt Vernon August 2021; source: Chris Bregman's Master DATs; stereo sony mic > dat master [3]
- **gd1995-05-19.aud.unknown.8600.shnf**: source: AT-835A?s & Nak 300?s > DAT [2]
- **gd1995-05-19.141345.FOB-mk4.ebel.flac1644**: taped by Ace Cubby; transferred by Pete Ebel; source: flac16 44.1khz Source Info:FOB Schoeps MK 4-> Reutelhuber P/S-> Teac DA-P20-> DAT (Ace Cubby)Transfer Info:Dat Tape (Panasonic SV-3700)-> Marantz CDR-615-> CD… [4]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Robbi Cohn: [1995-05-19 Sam Boyd Silver Bowl, U.N.L.V., Las Vegas, NV, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1995-05-19-sam-boyd-silver-bowl-u-n-l-v-las-vegas-nv-usa/) [19]
- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Sam Boyd Silver Bowl - May 19, 1995](https://www.dead.net/show/may-19-1995) [20]
